intended_purpose: An oral antihypertensive tablet indicated for the treatment of mild to moderate essential hypertension in adults.
device_description: Immediate-release film-coated tablet, 5 mg active pharmaceutical ingredient (amlodipine besylate equivalent), 30-tablet blister pack, oral administration once daily.
clinical_data_summary: Phase III RCT (n=612) demonstrated a statistically significant reduction in systolic blood pressure versus placebo at 12 weeks (p<0.001); standard pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic profile established in Phase I.
risk_summary: Standard drug safety profile per pharmacovigilance file; common adverse events include peripheral oedema and headache, consistent with the calcium-channel-blocker class.
